basic_info.name: ARKA Medical
basic_info.description: ARKA Medical: European Innovation Serving Health and SustainabilityARKA Medical is an innovative European company dedicated to the development, production, promotion, and commercialization of high-quality single-use medical and non-medical devices. Our mission is to address critical unmet needs in the healthcare sector, with a strong focus on cross-contamination risk mitigation, sustainability, and strengthening Europe’s sanitary resilience.With an investment of €45 million, ARKA Medical inaugurated the first examination glove manufacturing facility in Europe. This patented, fully automated, and technologically advanced industrial unit sets a new global benchmark in quality by ensuring 100% inspection of all gloves produced — an achievement unmatched in the industry worldwide.Our nitrile examination glove lines, R.Advance and R.Green, are developed and manufactured in strict compliance with regulatory and scientific standards, incorporating guidelines from the WHO, CDC, ECDC, and the professional consensus on clinical best practices. Entirely made in Europe, these solutions prioritize the safety of healthcare professionals and patients while reducing waste, supporting healthcare systems in their efforts to mitigate healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) and their systemic social and economic costs, and to adopt sustainable practices.Complementing our portfolio, ARKA Medical also develops and distributes a comprehensive range of medical devices and personal protective equipment (PPE) under the Rubbergold brand — ensuring complete #fromheadtotoe protection for healthcare professionals across all care settings.At ARKA Medical, we combine technology, science, and a deep commitment to public health to turn today’s challenges into tangible, sustainable, and safe solutions.For safer healthcare. For a better tomorrow.

We are your best bet if you are committed to resolving your chronic disease.
